reviews.title: Only Idle game I enjoy playing daily
reviews.text: This game is by far the best Idle RPG game I’ve played. The amount of stuff to do in this “idle” game is amazing. There are some items that definitely help you progress faster, but they are not required to interact with everything the game has to offer. reviews.title: Pay to win garbage
reviews.text: Gameduo hates their player base and all they want is for you to spend money on them. They clearly don’t want to see people do good in their game unless they have thousands of dollars to fork over for their events which is the only way to get late-game equipment. You can’t even get a full set of the best gear in the game without spending a few hundred dollars for literally one piece of gear. It’s a wonderful game at its core but the monetization makes me sick to my stomach and I just wish the people running it would care more about the player experience than the money in their pockets. Truly heartbreaking to see such a good game run into the ground by corporate greed.

reviews.text:
This game has THE MOST features I’ve ever seen in a single game. Including server and guild chat, so social elements too. However, the game will spend every ounce of its intelligence to convince you to purchase red gems for real money. This is the only way to get red gems. Special holiday event? Red gems. Once-a-month fishing event? Red gems.

However if you’re a swiper it’s the most fun I’ve had in any mobile game.

reviews.title: Best F2P idle game I’ve played
reviews.text:
I’ve tried my hand at a few idle games I’ve seen in ADs and on the App Store. This one by far has been the best. Could use some QoL changes to better assist new players with understanding mechanics. Luckily I found some YouTube videos and chatted with other players when necessary. This is the only reason I’m giving 4/5 stars, as gameplay mechanics should be properly communicated to the player in-game. Pixel art is amazing and the F2P grind is paced well. Albeit it’s a grind but thats the whole point. Paid features are available, but not overbearing, forced or required for progression (as it should be).

TLDR; great game, great art, great community, and when you’re stuck just ask questions, do a little research, and poke around in-game. The progression is satisfying.

reviews.title: Fun game, but buggy
reviews.text: I enjoy this game a bit, I have played it everyday since I downloaded it months ago. The difficulty ramps up a lot while you progress and it makes achievements satisfying. The biggest issue I have is that it crashes quite often. I’d say it will crash 1 out of 5 times I play. What’s worse is that 9 out of 10 times the game crashes after watching an ad, without receiving the benefit from it. This must have happened hundreds of times to me at this point, and it’s so annoying. I’ll have to reboot the game and sit through ads to get a benefit I had already watched an ad for. Please fix this or I’m going to have to delete the app because I’m starting to get fed up.
